title: The Lion and the Mouse
text: A big lion was sleeping under a tree. A little mouse ran across his nose. The lion woke up and caught the mouse. “Please let me go,” said the mouse. “One day I will help you.” The lion laughed, but he opened his paw.

A few days later, hunters came to the forest. They caught the lion in a big net. The lion roared and roared, but he could not get out. The little mouse heard him. She ran to the net as fast as she could.

The mouse bit the ropes with her small, sharp teeth. Soon there was a big hole in the net. The lion was free! “Thank you, my little friend,” he said. Now he knew that small friends can be great friends.
